explanation: Cho–Choi–Park Conjecture 1.6, even case: i(G) ≤ (D²+4)/(D+2)² · n for isolate-free G with even maximum degree D. Here minDegree > 0 encodes isolate-free and nonempty. Cross-multiplying in ℕ is exact. It was proved by Cho–Kim–Kim–Oum (JCTB 2023, Corollary 1.3: i(G) ≤ (1 − D/⌊(D+2)²/4⌋)n, which expands to this bound for even D). The statement is correct and solved.
